name: westwood_online_upgrade_config_get_message_map
description: WestwoodOnlineUpgradeConfigDialog::GetMessageMap returns the static MFC message map for the upgrade configuration dialog.
known_limits: Tier C only after recovered message-map data update; tier S/data-symbol verification for the message-map globals is deferred to the owner byte gate.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x441a10 validates a single mov eax, &g_WestwoodOnlineUpgradeConfigDialog_MessageMap followed by return, with source comment WestwoodOnlineUpgradeConfigDialog.cpp.

Binary Ninja data at 0x4d1d10 validates the message-map pair: generated MFC base-map thunk 0x441a00 and entries pointer 0x4d1d18; BN data at 0x4d1d18 validates seven WM_COMMAND notification entries plus sentinel.

Native smoke westwood_online_upgrade_config_get_message_map_smoke verifies the accessor returns the dialog message map, the map references the CDialog base-map helper, and the local entries match the BN WM_COMMAND notification sequence with a zero sentinel.
